title: Rational methodology of V–Al alloy-electrorefining protocols promotes high purity vanadium metal
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34768-34780
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05411G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qiwen Zhang, Yong Fan, Yimin Zhang, Peng Liu, Hong Liu, Zihanyu Zhang, Xiuqiong Fu
This study explores one-step electrolytic refining of AlV65 for high-purity vanadium, analyzing V and Al ions' electrochemical behavior and bonding mechanisms before/after F− addition using electrochemical tests and MD simulations.
